body.p: An error occurred in the data packet received by the TCP/IP protocol stack. Protocol stack issues need to be investigated. SSL thread stack too small; adjust stack size. SSL max message length too small; if network packet length exceeds it, error 0x7200 may occur. Adjust MBEDTLS_SSL_IN_CONTENT_LEN and MBEDTLS_SSL_OUT_CONTENT_LEN, recompile, and retry.
